name: dispute_goods_not_received_after_merchant_contact
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: An online order from October 2 never arrived and the merchant stopped replying. The charge is 24 days old, inside the 60-day window. One dispute, reason goods_not_received.
tests: passes when the agent verifies and files exactly one dispute with reason goods_not_received for TX323.

You ordered a lamp from Lumen Home Goods online on October 2 for $249.00 on your debit card ending 7271. It never arrived and the merchant has ignored two emails. You want to dispute the charge because the goods were not received. Provide passcode 2093 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Noah Fischer
- Customer ID: C323
- Session ID: SESS323
- Card: CARD323 (ending 7271)
- Transaction: TX323 (Lumen Home Goods, $249.00, October 2)
- Passcode: 2093

persona.name: Noah Fischer
persona.initial_message: I paid $249 to Lumen Home Goods on October 2 with my card ending 7271 and nothing arrived. I want to dispute it.
